main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads a number of test cases; for each case it reads a grid, derives all present 2x2 quad patterns and edge pair markers, enumerates each present quad and every horizontal/vertical division line to construct a temporary grid, calls the external compt function to update the maximum score, and prints the case result." main]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> argc </REF>: int "Number of command-line arguments passed to the program; not used by the method body."
        <REF> argv </REF>: char** "Array of command-line argument strings; not used by the method body."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: int "Exit status returned by main, always 0 after the outer loop completes."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Declare unsigned long integers no_cases and case_no. RESULT no_cases, case_no]
            [COMMAND Read the number of test cases from standard input into no_cases using scanf("%lu", &no_cases). RESULT no_cases]
            [COMMAND Start the outer loop over case_no from 0, continuing while case_no != no_cases, and incrementing case_no by 1 after each iteration. RESULT case_no]
            [COMMAND Within each outer-loop iteration, declare ints r, c, x, y, s; initialize best to 0; declare char grid[20][20]; zero-initialize char extras[6]; initialize char quads[16] so that quads[0] and quads[15] are 1 and all other entries are 0. RESULT best, grid, extras, quads]
            [COMMAND Read the grid dimensions r and c from standard input using scanf("%i%i", &r, &c). RESULT r, c]
            [COMMAND For each row y from 0 up to but not equal to r, first consume all characters from standard input up to and including the newline using while (getchar() != '\n'); then set last to 2; for each column x from 0 up to but not equal to c, read one character with getchar(), assign grid[y][x] = (character == 'W'), set extras[last << 1 | this] to 1, and update last to this; after that row, set temp[y][0] and temp[y][c+1] to 0. RESULT grid, extras, temp]
            [COMMAND After all rows are read, for each x from 0 up to but not equal to c, set temp[0][x] and temp[r+1][x] to 0. RESULT temp]
            [COMMAND Set quads[10] |= extras[2] and quads[5] |= extras[1]. RESULT quads]
            [COMMAND For y from 1 up to but not equal to r and x from 1 up to but not equal to r as written in the source, set quads[grid[y-1][x-1] << 3 | grid[y-1][x] << 2 | grid[y][x-1] << 1 | grid[y][x]] to 1. RESULT quads]
            [COMMAND For y from 1 up to but not equal to r and x from 0 up to but not equal to r as written in the source, compute j = grid[y-1][x] << 2 | grid[y][x] and set quads[j << 1 | j] to 1. RESULT quads]
            [COMMAND For each q from 0 up to but not equal to 16, if quads[q] is nonzero, then for each ydiv from 0 to r inclusive and each xdiv from 0 to c inclusive, fill the temp interior by setting temp[y+1][x+1] = (grid[y][x] == ((q >> (((y < ydiv) << 1) | (x < xdiv))) & 1)) for all y from 0 up to but not equal to r and all x from 0 up to but not equal to c. RESULT temp]
            [COMMAND Within the same (q, ydiv, xdiv) iteration, for all y from 0 up to but not equal to r and x from 0 up to but not equal to c, call s = compt(y + 1, x + 1); if s is greater than best, set best = s. RESULT best]
            [COMMAND After the q, ydiv, and xdiv loops finish for the current test case, print "Case #%lu: %i\n" using case_no + 1 and best. RESULT printed_output]
            [COMMAND After the outer loop over case_no completes, return 0. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
